notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[b] Dialogue [/b]

Added a simple dialogue system to give proper directions to the player.

[b] Redesign [/b]

Changed the design of a few gameplay elements to further emphasize their use in the world.

[b] Visible stats [/b]

Added item stats to the UI instead of keeping them hidden to the player

[b] Tutorial level [/b]

This is something I try to avoid, and rather replace with a good introduction in a game. Turns out it was unavoidable in this case, and has therefore been added.
